title: Modulating single-molecule magnet behavior towards multiple magnetic relaxation processes through structural variation in Dy4 clusters

synthesis.procedure: Dy(tmhd)3·2H2O (0.02 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (15.0 mL). Then 5.0 mL dichloromethane solution containing HL (0.02 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for 4.0 h at room temperature. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate was concentrated by slow evaporation at 4 °C. After about one week, block-shaped yellow crystals were obtained.
synthesis.time: stirred 4.0 h; crystals after about one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate concentrated by slow evaporation at 4 °C to give block-shaped yellow crystals

properties.summary: Linear Dy4 SMM. χMT at 300 K is 56.82 cm3 K mol−1 (1000 Oe), remaining nearly constant to 20 K then falling to 39.94 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K, consistent with weak ferromagnetic compensation of Stark depopulation. Under zero dc field, χ″ is weakly frequency-dependent below 10 K with no peaks (111–2311 Hz) due to QTM. Approximate barrier ΔE/kB ≈ 1.44 K and τ0 = 1.32 × 10−6 s from ln(χ″/χ′) = ln(ωτ0) + ΔE/kBT. Under 3000 Oe, frequency-dependent χ″ peaks appear as QTM is suppressed.

measurements.conditions: zero dc field; estimated from ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T assuming one relaxation process

measurements.name: pre-exponential factor τ0
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; same estimate as ΔE/kB

synthesis.procedure: A solution of Dy(hfac)3·2H2O (0.03 mmol) in 25 mL of n-heptane was heated to reflux for 4 h. After cooling to 70 °C, a CH2Cl2 (5.0 mL) and DMF (2.0 mL) solution containing HL (0.03 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred for 1 h at 70 °C then cooled to room temperature. After filtration, the solution was kept in the dark and concentrated by evaporation at 4 °C. After about 3 days, needle-shaped light red crystals were obtained.
synthesis.time: reflux 4 h; stirred 1 h at 70 °C; crystals after about 3 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in n-heptane followed by addition of CH2Cl2/DMF ligand solution, filtration and dark slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; kept in the dark and concentrated slowly at 4 °C to give needle-shaped light red crystals

properties.summary: Linear Dy4 SMM. χMT at 300 K is 56.41 cm3 K mol−1, decreasing to 21.96 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K, attributed to Stark depopulation and/or weak antiferromagnetic coupling. Zero-field ac data show frequency-dependent χ′/χ″ with a single χ″ peak. Arrhenius fit above 10 K: ΔE/kB = 50.96 K, τ0 = 3.12 × 10−7 s. Optimum dc field 1500 Oe; under this field two slow-relaxation processes appear as QTM is suppressed. Cole–Cole α = 0.46–0.09 (2.0–16.0 K).

synthesis.procedure: Dy(dbm)3·2H2O (0.05 mmol) was dissolved in 20 mL of acetonitrile. Then 5 mL CH2Cl2 solution of HL (0.05 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for about 5 h at room temperature. The solution was filtered, kept in the dark and concentrated by slow evaporation at room temperature. After about 10 days, yellow block crystals suitable for single-crystal X-ray diffraction were isolated.
synthesis.time: stirred about 5 h; crystals after about 10 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction, filtration and dark slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; kept in the dark and concentrated slowly at room temperature to give yellow block crystals

properties.summary: Rhombus-shaped Dy4 SMM with two Dy sites. χMT at 300 K is 56.38 cm3 K mol−1, falling to 26.47 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K. Zero-field ac data show two χ″ maxima near 9.0 and 14.0 K (FR and SR). Arrhenius: FR ΔE/kB = 40.45 K, τ0 = 1.33 × 10−6 s; SR ΔE/kB = 113.63 K, τ0 = 2.49 × 10−8 s. Optimum field 1000 Oe; under this field more than two relaxation processes appear. Cole–Cole plots at 6–12 K show two semicircles; α = 0.18–0.66 at selected temperatures.
